purpose: Define player-facing Graphics/Video behavior before runtime implementation.

authority_state.project_governor_registration: REQ-GFX-001 / INV-VISUAL-ECONOMY / DEC-055 registered on this branch

preset_model.custom_transition_rule: Changing an individual quality group away from a named preset displays Custom without silently changing unrelated groups.

display_behavior.risky_change_rule: Resolution and display-mode changes require explicit confirmation and automatically revert on timeout or rejection.
display_behavior.named_preset_rule: Named quality presets do not silently change resolution, display mode, VSync or user-selected frame cap.

persistence_contract.apply_rule: Apply writes intended settings through UGameUserSettings.
persistence_contract.revert_rule: Revert restores the last applied values.
persistence_contract.restore_defaults_rule: Restore Defaults selects the project default candidate and project-safe display defaults before Apply.

evidence_ceiling: UX/source contract only. No compile, PIE, device, visual or performance acceptance.
